content.text: {"answer":"Ines Barrow","citations":["D047","D046"],"explanation":"The 2025-05-02 CRM note after kickoff says the real decision maker is the COO, Ines Barrow, and that the CFO only signs off on budget. This corrects the earlier 2025-03-10 pilot note naming CFO Pavel Ruud as the final sign-off."}
